INSERT INTO git_sync_pr_check_head (workspace_id, repo_resource_path, pr_number, head_sha)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, repo_resource_path, pr_number)
         DO UPDATE SET head_sha = EXCLUDED.head_sha, checked_at = now(), started = false
         WHERE $6
            OR ((git_sync_pr_check_head.head_sha <> EXCLUDED.head_sha
                 OR (NOT git_sync_pr_check_head.started
                     AND git_sync_pr_check_head.checked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'))
                AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR git_sync_pr_check_head.checked_at < $5))
         RETURNING 1
